It seems that by changing alloc-expr still-nanoda get a 22% walltime reduction but that is not reflected in the virtual cpu time.

Please ping me on arena related questions, I'm not reading all of Zulip.

I noticed this as well. Of course instruction counts are just an approximation, and in particular do not capture improvements due to data locality and cache friendliness. I'm open for suggestions on how to measure that more faithfully, while keeping the relative stability and reproducibility that we have using the instruction counters.
